CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS uah_event_log (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  tenant TEXT NOT NULL,
  site TEXT,
  area TEXT,
  asset TEXT,
  topic TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
  source TEXT,
  trace_id TEXT,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_uah_event_ts ON uah_event_log (ts DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_uah_event_tenant ON uah_event_log (tenant);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_uah_event_asset ON uah_event_log (asset);

INSERT INTO uah_event_log (tenant, site, area, asset, topic, event_type, severity, source, trace_id, payload)
VALUES (
  {{$json.tenant}},
  {{$json.site}},
  {{$json.area}},
  {{$json.asset}},
  {{$json.topic}},
  {{$json.event_type}},
  {{$json.severity}},
  {{$json.source}},
  {{$json.trace_id}},
  {{$json.payload}}::jsonb
)
RETURNING id;
